## Problem and behavior

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues (for example, Closes #123).

## Validation

List commands and results, tested platforms, and checks that were not run. Include screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve process ownership and window trust boundaries.
- [ ] `npm test` passes, or failures and unrun checks are explained above.
- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Shared logs and screenshots contain no credentials or private session data.
